answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 31568 Country: India Title: REGARDING NAME Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakatuhu!! Respected pious scholars, My name is kaynat shamsi....I am shamsi...I want to keep my name maryam..Will u suggest me what to add with name maryam or simple maryam will work??JAZAKALLAH Answer ID: 31568 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 749/749/M=1432) Maryam is nice name. There is no need to suffix or prefix it with some other name. However, you may add if you like, it is permissible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
